title: A Core Representation Theorem for Scheme-Invariant Collinear Factorization in QCD
summary: Collinear factorization and the leading-twist operator product expansion (OPE) in perturbative QCD express suitably inclusive observables in scale-separated kinematics as composites of perturbative short-distance coefficients with universal long-distance non-perturbative correlators such as parton distribution functions (PDFs), up to controlled power corrections.
